cssVars: --background; foreground mixed with 8% background in dark; --primary-foreground when checked in dark

propDocs.Switch.defaultChecked: Initial checked state; a form reset restores it.
propDocs.Switch.disabled: Disables pointer, keyboard and form submission.
propDocs.Switch.readOnly: Keeps focus and submission while preventing toggles.
propDocs.Switch.required: Requires the switch to be on for form submission.
